qa_pairs.question: What torque specification is used for the injection pipe coupling nut to injection pump and nozzle combination?
What section and subsection does this torque specification table cover?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 13-6 Fuel metering and regulation system, subsection 13 53 Fuel Injection Nozzles and Pipes.

qa_pairs.question: What screw type is specified for the M51/M41 injection nozzle combination to cylinder head connection?
qa_pairs.answer: M51/M41 type screws with 65 Nm torque specification.
